description: List the connected person's lending on Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet), across every wallet on their account: taken, the loans against their properties (active first, with maturity date, days to maturity, maturingSoon within 14 days, payoff today and its as-of time, APR and the property page where it is repaid); made, loans they funded; deposits, their position in the DeFi lending pool (value at current pool prices, pending redemptions, pool page link); and counts of the loans they took. A loan between two of their own wallets appears under both taken and made. Prepares nothing: repaying and depositing happen on fabrica.land. Needs the connection's portfolio:read grant.
name: get_my_loans
title: Get my loans
